notes: NightshiftTestToken is a community coin as a test, launched with the NIGHTSHIFT Launchpad at getnightshift.tech/launchpad. Its parameterless constructor mints all 100 TESTNS with 18 decimals once to msg.sender, the launch factory. Transfers are plain ERC-20 transfers with no fee, tax or limit. There is no owner, administrative control or ability to mint more. No application contracts are included. The pool pairs with IMD at a 1.25% pool fee. The opening price is derived from economics.initialMarketCapWei and totalSupply; pool.initialPrice records provenance only. Logo concept: a frog with dark skin, a hoodie and glowing eyes.
